theorems.name: Submission.codim1_zsl_pc_cauchy_limit_set
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (F : ℕ → Set (Euclid m)), (∀ i, MeasurableSet (F i)) → (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ i j : ℕ, N ≤ i → N ≤ j → volume (symmDiff (F i) (F j) ∩ ball (0 : Euclid m) R) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal η) → ∃ (σ : ℕ → ℕ) (F' : Set (Euclid m)), StrictMono σ ∧ MeasurableSet F' ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, Tendsto (fun i => volume (symmDiff (F (σ i)) F' ∩ ball (0 : Euclid m) R)) atTop (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
